description: FREE Upgrade Watch. Has this deployed contract's code changed since you checked it? Returns the current code fingerprint (proxy-aware: follows the proxy to its current implementation) for a chain (base, ethereum, bnb, arbitrum, optimism, polygon; default base) and address. Pass the code_fingerprint from an earlier Kestrova check as `fingerprint` to get `changed`: true when the code or the implementation behind the proxy changed (an upgrade). Call it before each approve, call or payment to a contract you checked earlier; when it changed, run scan_contract_address_preview again. RPC reads only, no scan, no key, no wallet. Code only: storage changes (owner, pause, fees) are not detected. Not an audit.
name: check_contract_code_changed
